# Scientific evidence review

Read [AGENTS.md](../../../AGENTS.md) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md). Inspect the changed prose with `data/claim_support_map.json`, `data/entity_register.json`, the technical supplement, reference entries, completion audit, and cited primary sources as relevant.

- Keep the 118 recognized elements, 20 hypothetical elemental placeholders, and particle-category counting convention distinct. Nuclear/particle archives provide dated identities under their specified scope. Labels or combinations do not supply availability, synthesis, structure, stability, or measured properties.
- Preserve the 80 numbered paragraphs and 199 candidate claims in the original draft and the supplied PDFs unless an explicit versioned revision is authorized. Check numbering, dependencies, and cited textual locations. A textual-support mapping does not establish enablement, novelty, eligibility, unity, inventorship, or successful filing.
- Require each changed assertion to retain its appropriate ESTABLISHED, CALCULATED, PROPOSED, or UNSUPPORTED evidence label. Numerical models and reference preparation routes must not become applicant experiments or verified new embodiments. Evaluate whether stated composition, structure/phase, charge, stoichiometry, process history, characterization, and use actually appear in the evidence.
- Treat opposite-property scenarios as conditional hypotheses requiring defined conditions and evidence; do not assert arbitrary combinations simultaneously possess incompatible properties. Compare quoted or paraphrased primary sources with the precise claim being supported.
- Separate document preparation dates, source editions, observed repository access, uncertified earliest public availability, priority, and an official filing receipt. Read `documents/current_status_addendum.md` alongside historical filing prose. Public access or verification is not a filing.

Report the exact statement/location, supporting evidence or its absence, why the mismatch matters, and a narrow correction. Preserve unknowns and pending work. Follow the contributor-guide checks for structural consistency, but retain substantive scientific/legal gaps even when all automated checks pass. Never certify all or nearly all future patents blocked or invent applicant results, identity, inventorship, or filing facts.
